title: Identifying Cellular Reprogramming Networks via Transcription Factor Screening
author: Altman, Pértiga-Cabral, et al.

steps.title: Produce lentivirus in BSL‑2 hood
steps.instruction: Perform lentivirus production inside a designated BSL‑2 cell‑culture hood; use serological pipettes, pipette tips, tissue‑culture‑treated dishes and any lentivirus‑contaminated consumables and dispose of them according to institutional biosafety guidelines.

steps.title: Stain and prepare reprogrammed cells for FACS
steps.instruction: At the reprogramming endpoint (e.g., day 9), remove DMEM complete, wash cells with PBS, incubate with TrypLE for 10 min, neutralize detached cells with ice‑cold sorting buffer, transfer to a conical tube, centrifuge at 350 × g for 5 min, aspirate supernatant and resuspend the pellet in sorting buffer at 1 × 10⁶ cells per 100 µL, move the suspension to a FACS‑compatible 5 mL polystyrene round‑bottom tube, incubate with mouse serum (1:100) and the appropriate antibody (e.g., CD45) for 30 min at 4 °C in the dark, wash with sorting buffer, and store at 4 °C in the dark until sorting. Optionally reserve an aliquot for additional lineage‑specific marker staining.

substeps.instruction: a. Remove DMEM complete from plates.
b. Wash cells with PBS.
c. Incubate with TrypLE for 10 min.
d. Neutralize with ice‑cold sorting buffer.
e. Transfer to conical tube.
f. Centrifuge 350 × g, 5 min.
g. Aspirate supernatant; resuspend at 1 × 10⁶ cells/100 µL sorting buffer.
h. Transfer to 5 mL round‑bottom tube.
i. Add mouse serum (1:100) + antibody (e.g., CD45); incubate 30 min, 4 °C, dark.
j. Wash with sorting buffer.
k. Store at 4 °C, dark until sorting.

steps.title: Sort reprogrammed and control cells by FACS
steps.instruction: Use a BD FACS AriaIII (or equivalent) with a 100 µm nozzle; set gates to exclude doublets and dead cells; define CD45⁺ population with a fluorescence‑minus‑one (FMO) control; sort a minimum of 1 × 10⁴ CD45⁺ reprogrammed cells into chilled 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes pre‑coated with 250 µL sorting buffer; in parallel sort CD45⁻ HLA‑DR⁻ non‑reprogrammed cells as a control.

substeps.instruction: a. Select appropriate sorter and 100 µm nozzle.
b. Exclude doublets and dead cells.
c. Use FMO control to set CD45⁺ gate.
d. Sort ≥1 × 10⁴ CD45⁺ cells into tubes with 250 µL sorting buffer.
e. Simultaneously sort CD45⁻ HLA‑DR⁻ control cells.

steps.title: Count sorted cells and assess viability
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the sorted Eppendorf tubes at 350 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, aspirate supernatant, resuspend the pellet in BD Sample Buffer, and count cells with a hemocytometer using a viability stain such as Trypan blue; expect ~60 % recovery of the sort count for HEFs on a BD AriaIII.

substeps.instruction: a. Centrifuge 350 × g, 5 min, 4 °C.
b. Aspirate supernatant.
c. Resuspend in BD Sample Buffer.
d. Count with hemocytometer and Trypan blue.

steps.title: Prepare mRNA expression libraries (WTA)
steps.instruction: Follow the BD Rhapsody mRNA Whole‑Transcriptome Analysis (WTA) and Sample Tag Library Preparation Protocol (Doc 23‑24117(03)) with these modifications: repeat the WTA index PCR product purification (dual‑sided cleanup) for two total rounds; quantify the purified products on a Qubit Fluorometer using the dsDNA High‑Sensitivity assay; assess library quality on an Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer with the High‑Sensitivity DNA Kit; expect amplified transcript fragments in the 250–100 bp size range on the Bioanalyzer trace.

substeps.instruction: a. Perform two rounds of dual‑sided cleanup of WTA index PCR product.
b. Quantify with Qubit dsDNA High‑Sensitivity assay.
c. Run Agilent Bioanalyzer High‑Sensitivity DNA Kit.
d. Verify fragment size 250–100 bp.

steps.title: Prepare targeted barcode libraries (optional)
steps.instruction: After two rounds of RPE on BD Rhapsody Enhanced Cell Capture Beads, use the REPROcode Custom Primer Panel (Table 1) and follow the BD Rhapsody System TCR/BCR Full‑Length and Targeted mRNA Library Preparation Protocol (Doc 23‑24013(03)) for the Targeted mRNA panel; perform a two‑step nested amplification with the BD Rhapsody Targeted mRNA and AbSeq Amplification Kit, running 10 PCR cycles for PCR 1; QC the final libraries on an Agilent Bioanalyzer, expecting a peak range of 350–600 bp with a strong peak at ~480 bp; store indexed libraries at –20 °C for up to six months.

substeps.instruction: a. Use REPROcode Custom Primer Panel with BD Rhapsody Targeted protocol.
b. Perform two‑step nested amplification; PCR 1 = 10 cycles.
c. QC on Agilent Bioanalyzer; expect 350–600 bp, strong 480 bp peak.
d. Store libraries at –20 °C (≤6 months).

steps.title: Pre‑process FASTQ files with SevenBridges
steps.instruction: Create a BD SevenBridges account and project; upload FASTQ files via the command‑line interface; add the BD Rhapsody Sequence Analysis Pipeline App (v3.0) to the project; generate a new task and run it, adding both R1 and R2 FASTQ files to the Reads tab and the appropriate reference genome files to the Reference Files archive; in App Settings set ‘Exclude Intronic Reads’ to False, enable ‘Generate Bam Output’, and set ‘Expected Cell Count’ to the anticipated number of cells (e.g., 20 000); after completion, review the HTML report, confirming at least 20 % cell recovery (or >50 000 reads per cell if barcode amplification was omitted).

substeps.instruction: a. Create account/project on BD SevenBridges.
b. Upload FASTQ files via command line.
c. Add BD Rhapsody Sequence Analysis Pipeline App (v3.0).
d. Create and run a new task.
e. Add R1 and R2 FASTQ files to Reads tab.
f. Add reference genome files.
g. Set ‘Exclude Intronic Reads’ = False.
h. Set ‘Generate Bam Output’ = True.
i. Set ‘Expected Cell Count’ (e.g., 20 000).
j. Review HTML report; ensure ≥20 % cell recovery or ≥50 000 reads/cell if no barcode amplification.

steps.title: Detect TF barcodes from BAM files
steps.instruction: Install Conda and Mamba, download the REPROcode pre‑processing tools (doi:10.5281/zenodo.17348409), create the REPROcode environment with `mamba env create -n REPROcode -f environment.yml` and activate it; prepare a FASTA file listing the 8‑bp variable barcode for each TF (e.g., `>SPI1\nCTGAACAT`); run the barcode detection script: `python bcodes.py --barcodes=tf-barcodes.fasta --technology rhapsody *_Bioproduct.bam > table.tsv`; the output table lists cell IDs, UMIs and detected TF barcodes.

substeps.instruction: a. Install Conda and Mamba.
b. Download REPROcode tools (doi:10.5281/zenodo.17348409).
c. Create environment: `mamba env create -n REPROcode -f environment.yml`.
d. Activate: `conda activate REPROcode`.
e. Prepare FASTA of 8‑bp TF barcodes.
f. Run detection: `python bcodes.py --barcodes=tf-barcodes.fasta --technology rhapsody *_Bioproduct.bam > table.tsv`.

steps.title: Analyze transcriptomic data with Seurat
steps.instruction: Load the Seurat object (.rds) generated by SevenBridges; filter cells (e.g., median + nMAD × mad_val), find 5 000 variable features, scale data, run PCA, compute UMAP using dimensions 1‑30, find neighbors (dims 1‑30), and cluster with resolution 2; test multiple resolutions between 0.6 and 3.0 in 0.2 increments to refine cluster granularity.

substeps.instruction: a. Load Seurat object: `library(Seurat); seurat.obj <- readRDS('object.rds')`.
b. Filter outliers (median + nMAD × mad_val).
c. `FindVariableFeatures(nfeatures = 5000)`.
d. `ScaleData(features = rownames(seurat.obj))`.
e. `RunPCA(verbose = FALSE)`.
f. `RunUMAP(dims = 1:30)`.
g. `FindNeighbors(dims = 1:30, verbose = FALSE)`.
h. `FindClusters(resolution = 2, verbose = FALSE)`.
i. Optionally test resolutions 0.6‑3.0 (step 0.2).

steps.title: Calculate TF UMI counts and enrichments
steps.instruction: Load the TF barcode matrix, group by TF barcode name and cell barcode, and compute distinct UMI counts per TF per cell; fill missing entries in the TF matrix; optionally binarize expression using the 99th percentile of a chosen gene signature.

substeps.instruction: a. `library(dplyr)`.
b. `matrixTF %>% group_by(TF.barcode.name, Cell.barcode) %>% summarise(UMI_count = n_distinct(UMI), .groups = 'drop')`.
c. Populate `matrixTF.filled` with the summarized counts.
d. Binarize using `quantile(ArrayGEX$DCsign,0.99) = 1` if needed.

steps.title: Identify TF enrichment in target cluster
steps.instruction: Source REPROcode helper functions, define analysis parameters (Ns = c(1000), n_perm = 1000, alpha = 0.05, cls = 1 for the target cluster), build results with `build_res`, test top‑N meta‑combinations using `test_topN_parallel`, extract significantly enriched TFs, and plot TF counts.

substeps.instruction: a. `source('REPROcode.helper.R')`.
b. Set parameters: `results.final <- list(); TFsaved <- list(); Ns <- c(1000); n_perm <- 1000; alpha <- 0.05; cls <- 1`.
c. `res <- build_res(ArrayGEX, matrixTF.filled, cls)`.

d. Loop over Ns: `for (N in Ns) { res_top <- test_topN_parallel(res, N, n_perm = n_perm, alpha = alpha); results.final[[paste0('Clust:',cls,';TopCombo:',N)]] <- res_top; TFsubs <- as.character(res_top[res_top$significant==TRUE,1]); TFsaved[['Combo']] <- TFsubs; plot_tf_counts(res_top, N, cls) }`.

steps.title: Assemble 3‑ and 4‑TF meta‑combinations
steps.instruction: Run `process_rep` with the enriched TF list to generate 3‑TF and 4‑TF meta‑combinations for the defined cluster, print the results, modify `process_rep` as needed to incorporate the specific gene signature, document all parameters, save intermediate outputs, and validate findings across multiple samples.

substeps.instruction: a. `rep1 <- process_rep(ArrayGEX, matrixTF.filled, TFsaved$Combo, cls)`.
b. `print(rep1$res3)  # 3‑TF meta‑combinations`.
c. `print(rep1$res4)  # 4‑TF meta‑combinations`.
d. Adjust `process_rep` to specify the gene signature of interest.
e. Record all analysis parameters, save outputs, and cross‑validate.
